messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v3.4.1 -> route main-api, 10% traffic. Backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-v3.4.1 :rocket:

alex: Noted. Any DB migration in this deploy? :eyes:

maya: No destructive migrations. small add-col to user_metadata with default NULL, feature-gate controlled. Rollout safe for canary but watch for 500s on write paths.

jon: Seeing an uptick in 502s from the workers cluster at t+6m, p50 latency +30%. Not huge yet but trending.

priya: Can we pin traffic back to v3.4.0 if it worsens? What's the command sequence?

maya: Yes. Pin steps in runbook but quick form: 
```
# pin to previous image
kubectl set image deploy/main-api main-api=registry.redwood/v3.4.0 --namespace=prod
deploy-bot pin v3.4.0 --scope=traffic
```
Followed by aborting any pending rollout in console.

jon: I'm patching an infra knob to reduce worker concurrency now. If errors continue >1% for 3m we should backout.

tina: Adding monitoring checkpoints: error-rate, p95 latency, job queue backlog. Alert at 1% errors or p95 > 600ms for 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary metric snapshot (t+8m): error_rate=0.9%, p95=420ms, throughput stable. Metrics link: https://observability.redwood/graphs/abc123 :white_check_mark:

alex: Good catch. Let's give the infra change 5m. If it doesn't drop below 0.8% we pin. Who will execute pin?

priya: I can execute pin and cut traffic. Will coordinate with oncall.

jon: FYI, if pin fails due to pod crashloop, fallback plan is to scale up v3.4.0 replicas and shift traffic gradually (see runbook step 4).

maya: Also reminder: clear the KV cache after pin to avoid stale embeddings mismatch: `redis-cli -h redis-prod FLUSHDB namespace=embeddings` (run during low load).

priya: 10:25am PT - initiating pin if by 10:30am no improvement. tagging @tina on rollback ops. :timer_clock:

deploy-bot: Scheduled hold window at 10:30am. If pinned, will log incident and trigger post-deploy checklist.

tina: Acknowledged. I'll stand by to run the pin and then validate inbound traffic.

jon: Patch reduced concurrency, error rate dipped to 0.6% at t+13m. Holding and observing for 10m.

alex: Thanks team. If it remains <0.8% at 10:40am we continue rollout to 25%. If it rebounds, full backout plan (runbook link) is greenlit. :thumbsup:
_meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread for release coordination referencing backout runbook and pinning steps. Conforms to agents.md: single continuous string of messages, includes root message and replies, participants list, timestamps.
